title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://cdn.876553.xyz/Q1fc8a9OCb7AsC6f/dl/7e86f0a7-1f6f-… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A URL associated with attacker activity was observed multiple times on 2026-11-15 by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The URL is linked to the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it may be used for downloading malicious tools or payloads. The attacker infrastructure was identified in Taiwan. Security teams are advised to block and monitor this URL and search their proxy, web, and WAF logs for any requests to it.
